title: Add destination_v17: the speed-scaled clock with no back-off and a 30-update window
summary: destination_v17 is destination_v16 without any back-off and with a 30-update (1080-control) window. Attempt 8 of destination_v16 tracked 0.125 m/s at 0.80-0.92 of the destination pay, but the 5 cm rule lowered the level within about 10 updates every time and it cycled 0.075 to 0.125 m/s 10 times in 587 updates. The level now rises only when the destination pay averages above 0.8 over 30 updates at the level without a fall, and it never falls.
next: Train destination_v17 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
